subject: C6 frontend audit: ranked blockers
body:
C6 review 4f3ad8ed..0ffccc0f (source-only, no builds/tests). Ranked:
1 MSAA multi-draw (render_encoder.inc ~2450 sidecar: load_action hardcoded 2; bridge/pass refuse Load): draw #2 in a 4x pass re-clears draw #1; clear-only 4x pass never resolves (endEncoding skips textureSamples!=1). Silent corruption. Repro: 4x pass, clear, draw A (left), draw B (right), resolve must show both. Fix: refuse draw#2 / emit resolve for clear-only.
2 No tile-buffer budget guard: n2r fixes 256px tile, color_buffer_allocation=sum(bpp)*256*samples; Mesa pan_select_tile_size keeps <=8KiB (G57/G77 16KiB colour TB halved for pipelining). 4x with 3-4 RGBA8 / 2+ RGBA16F / RGBA32F admitted by n2r_render_targets_check + nord2_render_pass. Repro: 4x pass, 4xRGBA16F expect refusal. Fix: refuse sum(bpp)*samples>32.
3 DRAW lacks multisample_enable (panvk sets it when sample_count>1): likely aliased edges, MSAA only nominal. Needs hardware/decoder evidence.
4 Async newFunction/newRenderPipelineState completion: exactly once incl failure/inert, but +1 object never released after handler (leaks pipeline+code BO per call). Handler runs inline on caller thread.
5 Latent compute: table-fill 'goto cleanup' with e==0 returns success without submit; fau_count>128 return leaks cmd/local BOs (both unreachable now). Code BO omitted from job BO list at 32 handles (safe only because dispatch is synchronous). Bounds/BO retention of 31-buffer table otherwise OK (ext_seen==mask, spans checked, table in cmd BO). Test 31-buffer + TLS refusal.
6 encodeSignalEvent: invalidates only that command buffer (queue survives); NSError leaked at execute overwrite; event never signalled. minimumLinearTextureAlignment returns 64 but buffer-backed texture returns nil.
Sync: bundle/Mali .a 06:26 > newest source 05:39; staged pipeline_format.h ce462be8 and compiler sources identical to metal/tegu; addons 622919de/db8f0606 match receipts. C6-safe: non-MSAA/TLS draws unchanged; new selectors + dispatch_v2 only.
